title: Compression candidate record
description: Per-candidate record contract for the ~90 GiB memory-matched MiMo-V2.6-Flash compression sweep (docs/experiments/compression-sweep.md). One record per candidate recipe. Every byte figure is an exact integer traceable to manifests/models/mimo-v2.6-flash-rl/memory-report.json or inventory.json field arithmetic (never approximated). Every quality/performance measurement is null (or an empty array) until measured - never zero-filled, never inferred. Performance fields are PRE-OPTIMISATION diagnostics and are excluded from quality ranking.

status.description: Lifecycle state. planned = spec only (design phase); killed must name the stage in metrics.kill.

notes.description: Free-form provenance or caveat notes; null when none.

repo_id.description: Original Xiaomi source only. The tacodevs MLX checkpoint is prior information and is NEVER a construction source.

revision.description: Pinned source revision; all candidates are constructed from these ORIGINAL weights.

file_count.description: Source tree file count (90 for the pinned revision).

total_bytes.description: Source tree total bytes (177767644228 for the pinned revision).

digest_basis.description: How the on-disk digests were verified, e.g. 'inventory.json source.files[].lfs_sha256 recomputed against $MIMO_LAB/source-models/...'. Placeholders only; never absolute local paths.

class_bytes.description: Exactly units * bytes_per_unit; integer bytes, no rounding.

second_gen.description: true iff this class's values were re-encoded from decoded source weights (second-generation quantization).

bit_exact.description: true iff the stored bytes are a bit-exact copy of the source tensor payload (or an exact dense row-slice of it, router only).

source_field.description: memory-report.json / inventory.json field name, or the exact integer formula, the row derives from.

retained_total_experts.description: retained_experts_per_layer * 47 MoE layers (total retained expert instances).

allocation_table.description: One row per tensor class; rows sum exactly to size.resident_weight_bytes.

extra_q3_layers.description: MoE layer indexes (1-based) whose Q3 count is extra_q3_per_layer: the first (q3_instances mod 47) by layer index.

extra_q3_per_layer.description: Q3 count for each listed extra layer, always base_q3_per_layer + 1; 0 with an empty layer list when q3_instances is 0. Invariant: base_q3_per_layer * 47 + len(extra_q3_layers) * (extra_q3_per_layer - base_q3_per_layer) == q3_instances.

assignment_rule.description: Which retained experts receive Q3 within a layer (lowest REAP salience first; highest-salience survivors keep bit-exact native MXFP4). Byte totals are independent of the choice because every instance costs identically.

scope.description: Exactly which tensors were re-encoded, e.g. '6,981 of 8,413 retained expert instances (lowest REAP salience first)'.

reason.description: Why the matched budget required this class-by-class reduction.

second_gen_applied.description: Exhaustive list of every second-generation quantization applied to this candidate. Empty array = none anywhere (bit-exact MXFP4 passthrough plus native stored copies only).

resident_weight_bytes.description: Unit: bytes. Exact summed stored payload of the candidate text model (all allocation_table rows). Container/metadata overhead is not claimed before export.

gib.description: Unit: GiB (bytes / 2^30). Never mixed with decimal GB.

decimal_gb.description: Unit: decimal GB (bytes / 10^9). Never mixed with GiB.

residual_bytes.description: Unit: bytes. resident_weight_bytes - target_bytes; may be negative.

pure_mxfp4_floor_bytes.description: Unit: bytes. Total if every surviving tensor stayed at native MXFP4 / native stored bytes with zero second-gen. Feasibility-honesty figure; may be outside tolerance.

delta_perplexity.description: Unit: perplexity points vs original MiMo on this context-length slice; null until measured.

agreement_fraction.description: Unit: fraction in [0,1]; null until measured.

stage_reached.description: Staged-eval stage reached (1..4); null until any stage executes.

criterion.description: The calibrated stage-kill criterion actually applied; null while not killed. Thresholds come from the stage config (placeholders until calibrated against stage-1 spread).

perplexity.description: Unit: perplexity (calibration set). Null until measured.

delta_perplexity_vs_original.description: Unit: perplexity points (candidate - original MiMo); positive = worse. Null until measured.

kl_divergence_nats.description: Unit: nats (per-token KL, original || candidate). Null until measured.

on_policy_nll_nats.description: Unit: nats per assistant token on on-policy generations. Null until measured.

top1_fraction.description: Unit: fraction in [0,1] (top-1 token agreement vs original MiMo). Null until measured.

code_fraction.description: Unit: fraction in [0,1] on the code slice. Null until measured.

reasoning_fraction.description: Unit: fraction in [0,1] on the reasoning slice. Null until measured.

agent_tooluse_fraction.description: Unit: fraction in [0,1] on the agent/tool-use slice. Null until measured.

long_context_degradation.description: Long-context degradation by sliced context length. Every slice key is always present; values null until measured.

reference.description: Artifact/manifest key pointing at the stored sample; never raw trace content, prompts, or repo identifiers.

pathological_generations.description: Obvious pathological generations observed. Empty array = none observed at any executed stage; explicitly recorded, never silently omitted.

benchmarks.description: Benchmark scores within practical limits. Empty array = none run yet; not_ran/skipped rows are explicit, never zeros.

method.description: How the number was produced; when non-null it must state the PRE-RUNTIME-OPTIMISATION kernel set used.

ranking_use.description: Throughput never selects or rejects the compression-quality winner: current kernels may favour one datatype as an implementation artifact.

pp.description: Prompt-processing throughput. Unit: tokens/s. PRE-OPTIMISATION diagnostic.

c1_decode.description: Decode throughput at concurrency 1. Unit: tokens/s. PRE-OPTIMISATION diagnostic.

c4_decode.description: Aggregate decode throughput at concurrency 4. Unit: tokens/s. PRE-OPTIMISATION diagnostic.

c8_decode.description: Aggregate decode throughput at concurrency 8. Unit: tokens/s. PRE-OPTIMISATION diagnostic.

theoretical_bytes_per_token.description: Unit: bytes per decoded token of active weights streamed (exact formula in docs/experiments/compression-sweep.md). Null until computed.

active_weight_bandwidth.description: Theoretical bytes/decoded-token divided by measured decode seconds/token. Unit of value: bytes/s. Null until both inputs exist.
